quote_segments: Cataclysmically portraying that 'studying VCE is like bleeding every single day in a world of enemies',
Mariam establishes a war-like battlefield regarding the struggles of VCE and exams, since the term 'bleeding' conjures a destructive image of blood loss due to the assessments.
Here / In this way, Mariam seeks to position VCE students – who potentially do not want to bleed in their studies –
into wholeheartedly focusing on their VCE
and as such are influenced to reconsider their stance on the importance of studying.
